title: Mumbai Hostel Warden Arrested for Alleged Assault on Two Boys
summary: A hostel warden in Mumbai has been arrested for allegedly assaulting two boys. The incident occurred at the Kandivalis Swagat Ashram, a residential facility for students. Authorities have launched an investigation into the matter. The arrest highlights concerns about safety and accountability within educational institutions.
summary_points: A hostel warden in Mumbai has been arrested for allegedly assaulting two boys.
The incident occurred at the Kandivalis Swagat Ashram, a residential facility for students.
Authorities have launched an investigation into the matter.
The arrest raises concerns about safety and accountability within educational institutions.
The incident is being investigated by local authorities.
title_hi: मुंबई में होस्टल वार्डन को दो लड़कियों के साथ हिंसा करने के आरोप में गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया

framing.center: Centrist coverage frames the story as a serious incident that requires attention from authorities, but does not take a strong stance on the issue. They focus on the facts of the case and the response of the police.
